structured_output.what_is_happening: A wave of "p(doom)" tokens launched on Solana over roughly the last 30 minutes. The theme is Eliezer Yudkowsky's AI-doom idea, and the tokens seem to be tied to a post by the X account @allTheYud (GeckoTerminal's twitter field points to that status). This token (Ecf8…) is one of at least 10 same-name clones. It was launched through a Meteora virtual curve (GMGN) and paid for a usepaid.app link. It pumped +356% in its first 15 minutes, then fell about 36% in 5 minutes and about 62% in 15 minutes, and is now around $236k market cap. Several earlier clones trade higher: the one launched about 25 minutes earlier (Exk6…) is at about $789k, and ARPw… is at about $533k.

narrative.description: p(doom), the AI-safety slang for the probability of AI catastrophe, tied to a post from the @allTheYud (Yudkowsky-related) X account. A search result shows @allTheYud displaying a profitable P(DOOM) position on pump.fun at a $417k market cap.
narrative.why_spreading: A famous AI-doom figure appears to be linked to or engaging with the ticker, and that set off a burst of clone launches. The attention is split across many contract addresses.

token_connection.why_this_token: Same name and ticker as the others, launched later (pair created 09:22 UTC). It is not the earliest or largest clone.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 10 same-name tokens. Exk6… ($789k market cap, $1.5M 1h volume), ARPw… ($533k, $1.7M 1h volume) and 3Voo… came earlier and are bigger. One pump.fun clone, 6aHoh…pump, has collapsed to $17k.

authenticity.evidence: 2,098 unique buyers against only 94 unique sellers in 30 minutes, 52 bundler wallets and 12 snipers point to a bot swarm chasing the clones. No paid DexScreener promotion. Only 7 GMGN page visits.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see X posts (the X page returned HTTP 402), so the real link to Yudkowsky is unconfirmed.

structural_risks: RugCheck flags 99.99% of LP as unlocked, although GMGN reports lp_burn_ratio 1.0, so the sources conflict
One holder has 80% of supply; it is unlabeled and may be the pool
Price has been falling hard (-62% over 15 minutes)
Liquidity is $35k against a $236k market cap

structured_output.counterargument: If Yudkowsky is really engaging with the ticker, the whole cluster could get another leg up, and a cheaper clone can catch overflow buyers. This token has solid 1h volume ($500k) and more than 2,000 buyers, so a rebound after a 62% drawdown back to 2x entry is possible.
unknowns: Whether the LP is actually burned

source_coverage.notes: Time-limited. The X status page returned 402 and DexScreener returned 403. Web search found only a pump.fun snippet showing an @allTheYud P(DOOM) position.

structured_output.thesis: A late, non-canonical clone in a crowded same-name cluster that is already dumping. For this trade to hit +100%, the whole theme would need to re-ignite and this contract would need to be the one that benefits. That is unlikely.
